description: This file defines a FavoritesProvider class that manages user's favorite recipe IDs in a Flutter application. It handles loading from and saving to local storage via shared_preferences, provides methods to add, remove, toggle, and clear favorites, and exposes observable properties to reflect favorite state, loading status, and load completeness.

classes.name: FavoritesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages user's favorite recipe IDs with persistent storage and provides methods to modify those favorites.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads persisted favorite IDs from local storage, updating internal state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a given recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a recipe ID to the favorites set and persists the change.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a recipe ID from the favorites set and updates storage.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a given recipe ID.

methods.name: _persist
methods.description: Private method that asynchronously saves current favorites to persistent storage.
